Verified Hysteria2 server %1$s will be installed.

The incoming home VPN server is off by default. Turn on Home VPN server in Settings and confirm the verified Hysteria2 component. Turning it off stops the server and hides VPN clients; profiles, keys and pairings are preserved. A static public IPv4 address and an externally reachable UDP port are required. Creating a profile does not prove port availability. LAN access is granted separately. The component is kept when turned off unless its removal is selected in the confirmation dialog.
The home VPN server will stop. VPN profiles and pairings will be kept. Remote access may disconnect.
